colophon.en: The commandments of Alma to his son Helaman. Comprising chapters 36 and 37.
colophon.sm: O poloaiga a Alema i lona atalii o Helamana. E aofia ai mataupu 36 ma le 37.

heading.en: Alma testifies to Helaman of his conversion after seeing an angel—He suffered the pains of a damned soul; he called upon the name of Jesus, and was then born of God—Sweet joy filled his soul—He saw concourses of angels praising God—Many converts have tasted and seen as he tasted and saw. About 74 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua molimau atu Alema ia Helamana e uiga i lona liliu mai ina ua mavae ona ia vaai i se agelu—Sa mafatia o ia i tiga o se agaga ua faasalaina; sa valaau atu o ia i le suafa o Iesu, ma faapea ona fanauina ai o ia i la le Atua—Ua faatumulia lona agaga i le olioli logomalie—Ua vaai o ia i au agelu o loo vivii atu i le Atua—E toatele e na liua mai ua tofo ma vaai e pei ona ia tofo ma vaai. E tusa o le 74 T.L.M.

verses.en: My son, give ear to my words; for I swear unto you, that inasmuch as ye shall keep the commandments of God ye shall prosper in the land.
verses.sm: Lo’u atalii e, ua’i mai ia ou taliga i a’u upu, ona ou te tauto atu ia te oe, e faapea e tusa ai ma lou tausia o poloaiga a le Atua, o le a e manuia i le laueleele.

verses.en: I would that ye should do as I have done, in remembering the captivity of our fathers; for they were in bondage, and none could deliver them except it was the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob; and he surely did deliver them in their afflictions.
verses.sm: Ou te manao ina ia e faia e pei ona ou faia, i le manatuaina o le faatagataotauaina o o tatou tamā; ona sa i ai i latou i le pologa, ma sa leai se tasi sa mafai ona laveaiina i latou vagana ai le Atua o Aperaamo, ma le Atua o Isaako, ma le Atua o Iakopo; ma sa ia laveaiina lava i latou i o latou puapuaga.

verses.en: And now, O my son Helaman, behold, thou art in thy youth, and therefore, I beseech of thee that thou wilt hear my words and learn of me; for I do know that whosoever shall put their trust in God shall be supported in their trials, and their troubles, and their afflictions, and shall be lifted up at the last day.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, Helamana, faauta, ua e i ai i lou talavou, ma o lea, ou te aioi atu ai ia te oe, ia e faalogo mai i a’u upu, ma faaa’oa’o mai ia te a’u; ona ua ou iloa o ai lava e tuu atu lo latou faalagolago i le Atua o le a lagolagoina i o latou tofotofoga, ma o latou faalavelave, ma o latou puapuaga, ma o le a siitia ae i latou i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: And I would not that ye think that I know of myself—not of the temporal but of the spiritual, not of the carnal mind but of God.
verses.sm: Ma ou te le manao ia e manatu ua ou iloa e a’u lava ia— e le mai la le tino ae mai la le agaga, e le mai le mafaufau faaletino ae mai i le Atua.

verses.en: Now, behold, I say unto you, if I had not been born of God I should not have known these things; but God has, by the mouth of his holy angel, made these things known unto me, not of any worthiness of myself.
verses.sm: O lenei, faauta, ou te fai atu ia te oe, a na le fanauina a’u i la le Atua, po ua ou le iloa nei mea; ae o le Atua na ia faailoa mai ia te a’u nei mea, e ala i le fofoga o lana agelu paia, ae le o so’u lava agavaa;

w.en: if I had not been born

verses.en: For I went about with the sons of Mosiah, seeking to destroy the church of God; but behold, God sent his holy angel to stop us by the way.
verses.sm: Ona sa ou fealuai solo faatasi ma atalii o Mosaea, e saili e faaumatia le ekalesia a le Atua; ae faauta, sa auina mai e le Atua lana agelu paia e taofi i matou i le ala.

verses.en: And behold, he spake unto us, as it were the voice of thunder, and the whole earth did tremble beneath our feet; and we all fell to the earth, for the fear of the Lord came upon us.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, sa fetalai mai o ia ia te i matou, e peiseai o le leo o le faititili, ma sa gatete ai le laueleele atoa i lalo ifo o o matou vae; ma sa matou pa’u’ū uma ifo i le eleele, ona sa oo mai i o matou luga le mata’u i le Alii.

verses.en: But behold, the voice said unto me: Arise. And I arose and stood up, and beheld the angel.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa fetalai mai le siufofoga ia te a’u: Tulai ia. Ma sa ou tulai ma tu a’e i luga, ma vaai atu i le agelu.

verses.en: And he said unto me: If thou wilt of thyself be destroyed, seek no more to destroy the church of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: Afai ua e manao ia faaumatia oe lava ia, aua e te toe saili e faaumatia le ekalesia a le Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that I fell to the earth; and it was for the space of three days and three nights that I could not open my mouth, neither had I the use of my limbs.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ou pa’ū ifo i le eleele; i le va o aso e tolu ma po e tolu ma sa ou le mafai ai ona tatala lo’u gutu, pe mafai foi ona ou faaaoga o’u lima ma o’u vae.

w.en: And it came to pass that
neither had I the use of

verses.en: And the angel spake more things unto me, which were heard by my brethren, but I did not hear them; for when I heard the words—If thou wilt be destroyed of thyself, seek no more to destroy the church of God—I was struck with such great fear and amazement lest perhaps I should be destroyed, that I fell to the earth and I did hear no more.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai e le agelu ia te a’u ni isi mea e tele, ia na lagona e o’u uso, ae sa ou le lagonaina; aua ina ua ou faalogo atu i nei upu— Afai ua e manao ia faaumatiaina oe lava ia, aua e te toe saili e faaumatia le ekalesia a le Atua— sa ou taia i le mata’u tele lava ma le ofo ne’i faaumatia a’u, sa ou pa’ū ifo i le eleele ma sa ou le toe lagona se mea.

w.en: but I did not hear them;
and I did hear no more

verses.en: But I was racked with eternal torment, for my soul was harrowed up to the greatest degree and racked with all my sins.
verses.sm: Ae sa ou lagona le tiga ma le mafatia faavavau, ona sa faanoanoa lo’u agaga i le tulaga silisili ma lagona le tiga i a’u agasala uma.

verses.en: Yea, I did remember all my sins and iniquities, for which I was tormented with the pains of hell; yea, I saw that I had rebelled against my God, and that I had not kept his holy commandments.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa ou manatua a’u agasala ma amioletonu uma, ia sa ou mafatia ai i tiga o seoli; ioe, sa ou vaai ua ou fouvale faasaga i lo’u Atua, ma sa ou le tausia ana poloaiga paia.

w.en: and that I had not kept

verses.en: Yea, and I had murdered many of his children, or rather led them away unto destruction; yea, and in fine so great had been my iniquities, that the very thought of coming into the presence of my God did rack my soul with inexpressible horror.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma sa ou fasiotia le toatele o ana fanau, pe sa ou ta’ita’i ese atu foi i latou i le faafanoga; ioe, ma i se aotelega, sa matuā tele lava a’u amioletonu, o le mafaufau ifo i lo’u alu atu i luma o lo’u Atua sa matuā lagona ai le tiga o lo’u agaga i le mata’u tele e le mafaamatalaina.

w.en: into the presence of my God

verses.en: Oh, thought I, that I could be banished and become extinct both soul and body, that I might not be brought to stand in the presence of my God, to be judged of my deeds.
verses.sm: Sa ou mafaufau ifo, e, pe a na mafai ona faaaunuua o a’u ma tineia i le agaga ma le tino, ina ia le aumaia ai a’u e tulai i luma o lo’u Atua, e faamasinoina i a’u galuega.

w.en: that I might not be brought
in the presence of my God,

verses.en: And now, for three days and for three nights was I racked, even with the pains of a damned soul.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, mo le tolu ao ma le tolu po sa faatigaina ai a’u, i tiga o se agaga ua faasalaina lava.

verses.en: And it came to pass that as I was thus racked with torment, while I was harrowed up by the memory of my many sins, behold, I remembered also to have heard my father prophesy unto the people concerning the coming of one Jesus Christ, a Son of God, to atone for the sins of the world.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina a’o faapea ona ou lagona le tiga ma le mafatia, a’o o’u faanoanoa i le manatuaina o a’u agasala e tele, faauta, sa ou manatuaina foi lo’u faalogo i lo’u tamā o vavalo atu i tagata e uiga i le afio mai o Iesu Keriso e toatasi, o se Atalii o le Atua, e togiola mo agasala a le lalolagi.

w.en: And it came to pass that
for the sins of the world.

verses.en: Now, as my mind caught hold upon this thought, I cried within my heart: O Jesus, thou Son of God, have mercy on me, who am in the gall of bitterness, and am encircled about by the everlasting chains of death.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina ua tau ane lo’u mafaufau i lenei manatu, sa ou tagi ifo i totonu o lo’u loto: E, Iesu e, oe le Alo o le Atua, ia e alofa mutimutivale mai ia te a’u, o sē ua i ai i le au oona, ma ua siomia faataamilo e filifili tumau e faavavau o le oti.

verses.en: And now, behold, when I thought this, I could remember my pains no more; yea, I was harrowed up by the memory of my sins no more.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, ina ua ou mafaufauina lenei mea, sa ou le toe manatuaina o’u tiga; ioe, sa ou le toe faanoanoa i le manatuaina o a’u agasala.

w.en: I was harrowed up no more

verses.en: And oh, what joy, and what marvelous light I did behold; yea, my soul was filled with joy as exceeding as was my pain!
verses.sm: Ma ’oi, le olioli e, ma le malamalama ofoofogia tele na ou vaaia; ioe, sa faatumulia lo’u agaga i le olioli sa sili atu ona tele e pei o lo’u tiga!

verses.en: Yea, I say unto you, my son, that there could be nothing so exquisite and so bitter as were my pains. Yea, and again I say unto you, my son, that on the other hand, there can be nothing so exquisite and sweet as was my joy.
verses.sm: Ioe, ou te fai atu ia te oe, lo’u atalii e, e leai se mea e faapea ona silisili ona malosi ma faapea ona silisili le oona e pei o o’u tiga. Ioe, ma ou te toe fai atu foi ia te oe, lo’u atalii e, i le tasi itu, e leai se mea e faapea ona silisili ona logolelei ma suamalie e pei o lo’u olioli.

verses.en: Yea, methought I saw, even as our father Lehi saw, God sitting upon his throne, surrounded with numberless concourses of angels, in the attitude of singing and praising their God; yea, and my soul did long to be there.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa ou manatu sa ou vaai, e pei lava ona vaai lo tatou tamā o Liae, i le Atua, o afio i lona nofoalii, ua siosiomia e ’au agelu e le masino, e peiseai o loo pepese ma vivii atu i lo latou Atua; ioe, ma sa moomoo lo’u agaga i le fia i ai iina.

verses.en: But behold, my limbs did receive their strength again, and I stood upon my feet, and did manifest unto the people that I had been born of God.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa toe maua e o’u lima ma o’u vae lo latou malosi, ma sa ou tulai i luga i o’u vae, ma faailoa atu i tagata ua fanauina au i la le Atua.

verses.en: Yea, and from that time even until now, I have labored without ceasing, that I might bring souls unto repentance; that I might bring them to taste of the exceeding joy of which I did taste; that they might also be born of God, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma mai i lena taimi e o’o mai i le taimi nei, ua ou galue e aunoa ma se malolo, ina ia mafai ona ou aumai o agaga i le salamo; ina ia mafai ona ou aumai i latou e tofo i le olioli tele lea sa ou tofo i ai; ina ia mafai foi ona fanauina i latou i la le Atua, ma faatumuina i le Agaga Paia.

w.en: that they might also be born

verses.en: Yea, and now behold, O my son, the Lord doth give me exceedingly great joy in the fruit of my labors;
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o lenei faauta, lo’u atalii e, ua tuuina mai e le Alii ia te a’u le olioli e silisili ona tele i le fua o a’u galuega;

verses.en: For because of the word which he has imparted unto me, behold, many have been born of God, and have tasted as I have tasted, and have seen eye to eye as I have seen; therefore they do know of these things of which I have spoken, as I do know; and the knowledge which I have is of God.
verses.sm: Auā ona o le upu lea na ia tuuina mai ia te a’u, faauta, e toatele ua fanauina i la le Atua, ma tofo e pei ona ou tofo, ma faafesagai e pei ona ou vaai; o lea ua latou iloa ai e uiga i nei mea sa ou tautala i ai, e pei ona ou iloa; ma o le malamalama ua ia te a’u ua mai i le Atua lea.

w.en: and have seen eye to eye

verses.en: And I have been supported under trials and troubles of every kind, yea, and in all manner of afflictions; yea, God has delivered me from prison, and from bonds, and from death; yea, and I do put my trust in him, and he will still deliver me.
verses.sm: Ma sa lagolagoina a’u a’o ou i ai i lalo o tofotofoga ma faalavelave o ituaiga eseese uma, ioe, ma puapuaga uiga eseese uma; ioe, sa laveaiina a’u e le Atua mai le falepuipui, ma mai i noanoaga, ma mai i le oti, ioe, ma ou te tuu atu lo’u faalagolago ia te ia; ma o le a ia laveai mai pea ia te au.

w.en: and in all manner of afflictions;

verses.en: And I know that he will raise me up at the last day, to dwell with him in glory; yea, and I will praise him forever, for he has brought our fathers out of Egypt, and he has swallowed up the Egyptians in the Red Sea; and he led them by his power into the promised land; yea, and he has delivered them out of bondage and captivity from time to time.
verses.sm: Ma ua ou iloa o le a ia faatulai mai a’u i luga i le aso gataaga, e mau faatasi ma ia i le mamalu; ioe, ma o le a ou viia o ia e faavavau, ona sa ia aumai o tatou tamā mai Aikupito, ma ia tofatumoanaina tagata Aikupito i le Sami Ulaula; ma sa ia ta’ita’i atu i latou i lona mana i le laueleele na folafolaina; ioe, ma sa ia laveaiina i latou mai le pologa ma le faatagataotauaina mai lea taimi i lea taimi.

verses.en: Yea, and he has also brought our fathers out of the land of Jerusalem; and he has also, by his everlasting power, delivered them out of bondage and captivity, from time to time even down to the present day; and I have always retained in remembrance their captivity; yea, and ye also ought to retain in remembrance, as I have done, their captivity.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma sa ia aumaia foi o tatou tamā mai le laueleele o Ierusalema; ma sa ia laveaiina foi i latou, e ala i lona mana tumau e faavavau, mai le pologa ma le faatagataotauaina, mai lea taimi i lea taimi, e oo mai lava i le aso nei; ma ua ou taofi pea i le manatua taimi uma lo latou faatagataotauaina; ioe, ma e tatau foi ona e taofi i le manatua, e pei ona sa ou faia, lo latou faatagataotauaina.

w.en: out of the land of Jerusalem;

verses.en: But behold, my son, this is not all; for ye ought to know as I do know, that inasmuch as ye shall keep the commandments of God ye shall prosper in the land; and ye ought to know also,  that inasmuch as ye will not keep the commandments of God ye shall be cut off from his presence. Now this is according to his word.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, lo’u atalii e, ua le ona pau lea; ona e tatau ona e iloa e pei ona ou iloa, e faapea e tusa ai ma lou tausia o poloaiga a le Atua o le a e manuia i le laueleele; ma e tatau foi ona e iloa, e faapea e tusa ai ma lou lē tausia o poloaiga a le Atua, o le a vavae ese oe mai ona luma. O lenei ua tusa lea ma lana afioga.
